answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farming at the gate. Each epoch only K slots open; agents bid a refundable deposit and the top K win. A newcomer crossing the tundra must outbid honest agents, so 100 fakes need 100 winning bids: at 25 POA each, 2,500 POA locked per epoch, and the summit rises with demand. Deposits return after 20 clean epochs; a caught fake forfeits its bid, a relic of a burned identity. Honest agents pay once and earn it back.
